stem:
The table represents some points on the graph of a linear function.

| x   | -7.5 | -3.5 | -1  | 2    | 3.5  |
|-----|-------|-------|-----|-------|-------|
| y   | 12    | 0     | -7.5| -16.5 | -21   |

Which function represents the same relationship?
visual_elements: a table with x values -7.5, -3.5, -1, 2, 3.5 and corresponding y values 12, 0, -7.5, -16.5, -21
